<span class="eyebrow">Courses · Seminars · Summer Schools</span>

<p class="lede">Over twenty years of teaching statistics, machine learning, and data science across bachelor's, master's, and doctoral programmes — at the University of Naples Federico II and in international summer schools.</p>

## Courses Taught

- **Statistics for Social Sciences** — Undergraduate course, Bachelor in Tourism Sciences
- **Quantitative Methods** — Undergraduate course, Bachelor in Tourism Management Sciences
- **Sampling Surveys** — Undergraduate course, Bachelor in Economics
- **Statistical Methods for Social Research** — Graduate level, Master in Economics, Curriculum *Data Scientist for Economics*
- **Lab in Machine Learning and Text Mining with R** — Graduate level, Master in Economics, Curriculum *Data Scientist for Economics*
- **Machine Learning Methods** — Ph.D. courses
- **Bibliometric Analysis using R** — Ph.D. courses and International Summer Schools

I have also taught at other universities: *Statistics* at the University of Basilicata, *Econometrics* at the Magna Græcia University of Catanzaro, and *Statistical Inference* at the Italian Air Force Officers' Academy in Pozzuoli.

---

## Seminars and Training Activities

Over the last few years I have delivered more than **60 invited seminars and training sessions** on bibliometric methods, machine learning, and data science for social research. These lectures have been held in many Italian doctoral schools — including the Universities of Bergamo, Brescia, Calabria, Genoa, Milan Polytechnic, Naples, Pisa, Rome, Salento, and Turin — as well as at international institutions such as the Universities of **Bodø (Norway)**, **Edinburgh**, **Glasgow**, **Granada**, **London**, **Melbourne**, and **Paris**, and the **NOVA Information Management School** in Lisbon.

I have also been a lecturer at the **European Summer School for Scientometrics (ESSS)**, and I am the founder and Scientific Coordinator of the **Summer School in Science Mapping (SSSM)**. Beyond academia, I have delivered methodological training for public institutions, including the Italian **National School of Administration (SNA)** and the Advanced Training School of the **Court of Auditors**.

Conference presentations and scientific committees are listed on the [Conferences](conferences.qmd) page.
